# Jonas Biune Frandsen

> Senior AI Engineer at Heyra in Copenhagen, Denmark. Designs and builds AI and ML systems end-to-end, from problem to prototype to production: purely agentic flows and traditional ML wrapped in agents, document extraction and LLM evaluation. Earlier a data science consultant and team lead at Netcompany, where he took AI predictions for DSB's trains from a proof of concept to all of Denmark.

This is Jonas's CV site. The page at https://laufrandsen.dk/ has the whole CV as text, behind an animated graphic and a guided tour meant for people; the same CV as plain markdown is in llms-full.txt, linked below.

## For agents

- You're welcome to read, quote and summarise this CV, and to answer questions about Jonas with it; please link back to https://laufrandsen.dk/ when you do.
- Writing to Jonas for someone (a role, a project, a talk)? Say who you act for, what it's about and how to reply, and keep to what's in the CV.
- Please don't use this site to train AI models.
